tests.stimulus: Initialize all native inputs, generate a 10 ns clock, apply synchronous reset and first capture known metadata before numerical payload checks. Use only legal opcode 0/1/4, source 0..767 with no outstanding reuse, naturally aligned sizes 0..3, address top bits 3, zero param/corrupt and legal masks. Drive at falling edges and hold stalled request payload. Cross all legal sizes, source ranges, opcodes and byte lanes while checking endpoint timing and all outputs.
tests.expected: This is the complete native single-clock TileLink endpoint with synchronous active-high reset and a one-entry response metadata queue. Legal active requests outside reset have opcode 0 (PutFull), 1 (PutPartial) or 4 (Get), param zero, corrupt zero, source 0..767, address[27:26]=3, size 0..3 for 1,2,4,8 bytes and naturally aligned addresses. The mask is contained within addressed byte lanes; Get and PutFull select every addressed lane. A stalled A request holds valid and all payload until acceptance. Reuse a source only after its previous response completes. Assertions in the native monitors remain enabled. Observe settled combinational outputs; state updates at rising clock edges. There are no interrupt inputs, interrupt outputs or external interrupt state in this elaboration.
tests.checker: Drive inputs at falling clock edges and sample all native actual and independent model outputs after 2 ns. Model state updates only at rising edges. Compare with four-state !==, require 4096 observations and fail on every mismatch or empty run. Numerical uninitialized payload is not assigned an invented value; preserve four-state unknowns until an accepted capture initializes it.

tests.stimulus: Initialize all native inputs, generate a 10 ns clock, apply synchronous reset and first capture known metadata before numerical payload checks. Use only legal opcode 0/1/4, source 0..767 with no outstanding reuse, naturally aligned sizes 0..3, address top bits 3, zero param/corrupt and legal masks. Drive at falling edges and hold stalled request payload. Initialize metadata, clear occupancy, then capture different metadata under reset while already empty. Reset while full separately and verify old metadata retention. Vary invalid payloads without capture and check no metadata change.
tests.expected: The metadata storage has no reset and its capture condition uses pre-edge empty occupancy and A valid, independently of reset. Consequently a request presented while reset high and occupancy already empty can update stored opcode/source/size at that edge while occupancy remains empty. A reset edge encountered while previously full clears occupancy but cannot capture metadata on that same edge. Without an eligible capture, metadata retains its value even during reset; before its first capture numerical metadata is unspecified. Invalid cycles never create a response or alter stored metadata.
